21. CONTRACT MODIFICATIONS:

a) Amendment to Contract No. 7521 between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie
County for Animal Control Services. (Revenue to the City)

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve in an amount of $130,800.00, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion
cartied by unanimous voice vote.

Eric Fountain, Compliance Director, provided a staff report and committee member Aldrich
‘commented on the item.

OTHER ITEMS FOR THE AGENDA:

a) Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne
Metropolitan Planning Organization, and TischlerBise for the Laramie County
Roads Impact Fee Study. (MPO Funds)

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $97,840.00, seconded by Mr. Roybal.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director, provided a staff report and
committee member Aldrich commented on the item.

b) Cooperative Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Wyoming
Department of Transportation for Project ARSCT NS61 A02, US 30/Pershing Blvd.
to Christensen Road, Cheyenne Streets, Laramie County. (2023-2026 Optional 1%
Sales Tax Fund and 2023-2026 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $2,823,800.00, seconded by Mr. Roybal.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Tom Cobb, City Engineer, provided a staff report and committee member Aldrich commented on
the item. Public comment was made by Don Odum and Micheal White
